newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom names John Roth as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom names John Roth as CEO.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Thursday that chief operating officer John Roth, 54, would succeed Jean Monty as president and chief executive when Monty stepped down on October 1.
Monty, 49, will return to BCE Inc in October to assume a senior executive position.
Roth assumes the title of president immediately while staying in his position as COO. Monty will become vice-chairman and remain as CEO until his departure in October.

"Jean Monty has done an excellent job in transforming Nortel into a global growth company. At the same time, we believe John Roth is fully prepared to succeed Mr. Monty and continue Jean's outstanding leadership," L.R. (Red) Wilson, chairman and CEO of BCE, said in a statement.
